sources.name: labor
sources.note: 248/248 articles (238 substantive + 10 explicitly repealed placeholders, plus a few 'مكرر' bis additions — replaces the previous under-extraction of 188/245). Re-extracted with pdftotext. Fixed: ligature-order bugs (لأ/لإ/لآ systematically reversed to أل/إل/آل; scrambled word-final '-لاً' endings, e.g. تشغيلاً/مقبولاً), and chapter/part heading text bleeding into the tail of the preceding article. Known remaining noise: one isolated stray-diacritic artifact (cosmetic only).

sources.name: sama_banking_control_law
sources.note: 26/26 articles, AR+EN. Fully re-extracted with pdftotext (the previous version still used pdf-parse and had reversed/garbled Arabic). Fixed: ligature-order bugs (لأ/لإ/لآ and امل reversed), على/إلى/الأولى losing their ل, في losing its ف (102 instances), decorative tatweel, and one page-layout artifact where part of Article 19's text was displaced into Article 22. Known remaining gap: Article 22's second paragraph (about persistent contravention and license revocation) is present in English only — missing from the source PDF's Arabic text extraction entirely.

sources.note: 16/16 articles, re-extracted with pdftotext + line-level AR/EN classification (fixes a token-level bug in the previous pdf-parse version where English words with trailing punctuation, e.g. 'Law,'/'Article:', leaked into text_ar in all 16 articles).
